description: Test definitions for channel catalog contracts, including specific tests for various channel configurations such as 'msteams' and 'whatsapp'. The file imports helper functions to define these contracts and then specifies three distinct channel contract tests with associated metadata.

methods.name: describeChannelCatalogEntryContract
methods.description: Defines a test contract for a specific channel catalog entry, specifying properties such as channelId, npmSpec, and alias.

methods.name: describeBundledMetadataOnlyChannelCatalogContract
methods.description: Defines a test contract for a bundled channel catalog configuration that only includes metadata, specifying pluginId, packageName, and related metadata.

methods.name: describeOfficialFallbackChannelCatalogContract
methods.description: Defines a test contract for an official fallback scenario with external dependencies, including external npm specifications.

calls: describeBundledMetadataOnlyChannelCatalogContract({ pluginId: "whatsapp", packageName: "@openclaw/whatsapp", npmSpec: "@openclaw/whatsapp", meta: whatsappMeta, defaultChoice: "npm" })
